setup.title: Welcome
setup.subtitle: Set up your business and create the administrator account to start using the system.
setup.error: Could not complete the initial setup

inventory.title: Products
inventory.subtitle: Product setup: batch, expiry and reorder points.
inventory.name: Name
inventory.importHint: The file must have these columns: sku, nombre, categoria, marca, unidad_medida, stock_minimo, punto_reposicion, stock_maximo.

form.title: Product
form.name: Name
form.initialStockHint: If you enter a quantity, it's registered as the first incoming stock for this product.
form.warehouseRequired: Pick a warehouse for the initial stock
form.expiryRequired: This product tracks expiry: the expiry date is required to add stock
form.batchRequired: This product tracks batches: the batch number is required to add stock

batches.title: Stock
batches.subtitle: Available stock per product, by warehouse and batch. Stock entries and adjustments.
batches.incomingError: Could not register the incoming stock

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Set prices per list, with change history.
pricing.empty: No active products for this list.

sales.title: Sales
sales.subtitle: Register sales with automatic stock deduction (FEFO).

purchaseOrders.title: Purchase orders
purchaseOrders.subtitle: Create orders to suppliers and receive stock automatically.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Indicators and exports for decision-making.
reports.expiringHint: Based on each product's configured warning days (or already expired).

settings.title: Settings
settings.logoHint: PNG, JPG, SVG or WEBP, up to 2MB.
settings.colorPaletteHint: Pick one of the most common colors used in management systems, or set your own.
settings.languageHint: Sets the default language for new users.
settings.translationsHint: Provide the English translation for the values used in your catalog.
settings.reportFrequencyHint: How often the consolidated report of upcoming expirations and low stock is emailed to the users who have it enabled.
settings.nextReportHint: The check runs every day at 8:00 and on the first use of the app each day. The email is only sent when there are upcoming expirations or low stock to report. Sending it manually from Reports does not change this schedule. After changing the frequency and saving, the new period applies from the next check, counting from the last report sent.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Create users and assign a role with its corresponding permissions.
users.emailHint: Used to send low-stock alerts and, if enabled below, expiry reminders (optional).
users.roleRequired: Select a role for the user
users.passwordEditHint: Leave blank to keep it unchanged

scanner.title: Scan barcode
scanner.hintCamera: Point the camera at the barcode, or use a physical scanner and press Enter.
scanner.hintPhone: Scan with your phone's camera; the code will show up here automatically, nothing else to do.
scanner.pairingHint: Scan this QR with your phone's camera to link it. Once linked, you won't need to scan it again.
scanner.pairingListening: Waiting for the code from your linked phone...
scanner.pairingShowQR: Link a different phone / show QR
scanner.pairingLocalhostWarning: You're using the app on "localhost": your phone won't be able to connect. Open the app on the PC using your local network IP instead (e.g. http://192.168.x.x:5173) and generate the QR again.
scanner.unsupported: This browser doesn't allow camera access. Type the code manually.
scanner.permissionDenied: Couldn't access the camera. Check permissions or type the code manually.
scanner.error: There was an error reading the camera. Type the code manually.

remoteScan.title: Scan barcode
remoteScan.subtitle: Point the camera at the code. It will be sent straight to your computer.
remoteScan.sentHint: You can keep scanning another product.
remoteScan.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
remoteScan.invalidHint: Go back to the computer and generate a new QR code from the scan button.
